```{r}
library(ggplot2)   
library(dplyr)     
library(car)       
library(ggpubr)    
```
#check normality
```{r}
sum(!is.na(RPSA4$`RPSA1`))
sum(!is.na(RPSA4$`RPSA2`))
sum(!is.na(RPSA4$`RPSA3`))
sum(!is.na(RPSA4$`RPSA4`))
```
```{r}
library(nortest)
ad.test(RPSA4$`RPSA1`)
ad.test(RPSA4$`RPSA2`)
ad.test(RPSA4$`RPSA3`)
ad.test(RPSA4$`RPSA4`)

# Generate QQ plots
ggqqplot(RPSA4$`RPSA1`, title = "QQ Plot for RPSA One")
ggqqplot(RPSA4$`RPSA2`, title = "QQ Plot for RPSA Two")
ggqqplot(RPSA4$`RPSA3`, title = "QQ Plot for RPSA Three")
ggqqplot(RPSA4$`RPSA4`, title = "QQ Plot for RPSA Four")

# Generate density plots
ggplot(RPSA4, aes(x=`RPSA1`)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("Density Plot for RPSA One")
ggplot(RPSA4, aes(x=`RPSA2`)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("Density Plot for RPSA Two")
ggplot(RPSA4, aes(x=`RPSA3`)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("Density Plot for RPSA Three")
ggplot(RPSA4, aes(x=`RPSA4`)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("Density Plot for RPSA Four")
```
```{r}
# Create boxplots
boxplot(RPSA4$`RPSA1`, main="Boxplot for RPSA One", horizontal = TRUE)
boxplot(RPSA4$`RPSA2`, main="Boxplot for RPSA Two", horizontal = TRUE)
boxplot(RPSA4$`RPSA3`, main="Boxplot for RPSA Three", horizontal = TRUE)
boxplot(RPSA4$`RPSA4`, main="Boxplot for RPSA Four", horizontal = TRUE)

# Identify outliers
outliers_rpsa1 <- boxplot.stats(RPSA4$`RPSA One`)$out
outliers_rpsa2 <- boxplot.stats(RPSA4$`RPSA Two`)$out
outliers_rpsa3 <- boxplot.stats(RPSA4$`RPSA Three`)$out
outliers_rpsa4 <- boxplot.stats(RPSA4$`RPSA Four`)$out

# Print outliers
print("Outliers in RPSA One:")
print(outliers_rpsa1)

print("Outliers in RPSA Two:")
print(outliers_rpsa2)

print("Outliers in RPSA Three:")
print(outliers_rpsa3)

print("Outliers in RPSA Four:")
print(outliers_rpsa4)
```
```{r}
friedman_result <- friedman.test(as.matrix(RPSA4[, c("RPSA1", "RPSA2", "RPSA3", "RPSA4")]))
print(friedman_result)
```
```{r}
pairwise.wilcox.test(as.vector(as.matrix(RPSA4[, c("RPSA1", "RPSA2", "RPSA3", "RPSA4")])), 
                      rep(1:4, each=nrow(RPSA4)), 
                      paired = TRUE, 
                      p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```
```{r}
summary(RPSA4[, c("RPSA1", "RPSA2", "RPSA3", "RPSA4")])
boxplot(RPSA4[, c("RPSA1", "RPSA2", "RPSA3", "RPSA4")], main="Boxplot of Models", ylab="Values")
```


```{r}
library(corrplot)
```

#Calculate correlations and visualize correlation matrix 
```{r}
numeric_data <- RPSA4[, sapply(RPSA4, is.numeric)]
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix)
```

```{r}
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", tl.cex = 0.8)
```

#subset data by RPSA trial (RPSA1) 
```{r}
selected_vars1 <- RPSA4[, c("Population to Provider Ratio", "Time to NSC", "Below Poverty", "Physical Distress", "Physical Inactivity", "Mobility Disability",  "Self Care Disability", "Independent Living", "RPSA1")]
cor_matrix1 <- cor(selected_vars1, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix1)
```
```{r}
corrplot(cor_matrix1, method = "color", tl.cex = 0.8, type = "lower", addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.7, diag = FALSE)
```
#subset data by RPSA trial (RPSA2) 
```{r}
selected_vars2 <- RPSA4[, c("Population to Provider Ratio", "Time to NSC", "Below Poverty", "Physical Distress", "Physical Inactivity", "Mobility Disability",  "Self Care Disability", "Independent Living", "Arthritis", "Stroke", "Obesity","RPSA2")]
cor_matrix2 <- cor(selected_vars2, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix2)
```

```{r}
corrplot(cor_matrix2, method = "color", tl.cex = 0.7, type = "lower", addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.6, diag = FALSE)
```
#subset data by RPSA trial (RPSA3) 
```{r}
selected_vars3 <- RPSA4[, c("Population to Provider Ratio", "Time to NSC", "Below Poverty", "Physical Distress", "Physical Inactivity", "Mobility Disability",  "Self Care Disability", "Independent Living", "Arthritis", "Stroke", "Obesity","Transportation Barriers", "Lack of Health Insurance", "RPSA3")]
```


```{r}
selected_vars4 <- RPSA4[, c("Population to Provider Ratio", "Time to NSC", "Below Poverty", "Physical Inactivity", "Arthritis", "Stroke", "Obesity","Transportation Barriers", "Lack of Health Insurance", "RPSA4")]
cor_matrix4 <- cor(selected_vars4, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix4)
```

```{r}
corrplot(cor_matrix4, method = "color", tl.cex = .6, type = "lower", addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.5, diag = FALSE)
```
```{r}
corrplot(
  cor_matrix4,
  method = "color",
  tl.cex = 0.6,
  type = "lower",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.5,
  diag = FALSE,
  mar = c(4, 0, 0, 0)
)

mtext(
  "Note. NSC is Nearest Source of Care.",
  side = 1,
  line = 2,
  adj = 0,
  cex = 0.7
)
```

```{r}
png(
  "Correlation_Plot.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,

)

  type = "lower",
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.cex = 1,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.9,
  cl.cex = 0.9,

)
```
